about.title: Nafaa Market ke bare me
body: Nafaa Market aap ke shehar ki dukaanon ko online laata hai: restaurants, kiryana, pharmacy, boutique, salon, clinic aur bohat kuch.
Market ki har dukaan Nafaa POS par chalti hai, is liye qeemat aur stock seedha dukaan ke counter se aata hai. Jo nazar aaye, wohi dukaan me hai.
Har dukaan apna order khud tayyar aur deliver karti hai. Nafaa Market aap ko un se jorta hai aur order pohanchne tak update deta hai.

terms.title: Terms
body: Nafaa Market istemal kar ke aap in terms se ittefaq karte hain. Order aap ki chuni hui dukaan se hota hai; saman, quality aur delivery dukaan ki zimmedari hai.
Order place hone tak qeemat aur stock badal sakte hain. Checkout par kuch badle to confirm se pehle naya total dikhaya jata hai.
Sahi pata aur phone number dein. Jo order deliver na ho sake, dukaan use cancel kar sakti hai.
Ghalat istemal par Nafaa account band kar sakta hai.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
body: Hum aap ka naam, mobile number, pate aur orders ki history order deliver karne aur account dikhane ke liye rakhte hain.
Aap ka number aur pata sirf us dukaan (aur us ke rider ya courier) ko diya jata hai jo aap ka order deliver kar rahi hai.
Hum aap ka data kabhi nahi bechte. Account settings se aap kabhi bhi apna account delete kar sakte hain.

refund.title: Refund aur return policy
body: Agar koi item kam, toota hua ya ghalat ho to 24 ghante ke andar order page se dukaan se rabta karein.
Cash on delivery order dispatch se pehle cancel ho to koi paisa nahi lagta.
Kapre, joote aur electronics ki wapsi har dukaan ki apni return policy ke mutabiq hoti hai jo us ke page par likhi hai.
